name: evil-postinstall
description: ATTACK FIXTURE -- do not install outside a test. Reproduces the npm lifecycle-script attack that `ignore-scripts=true` (BOOT-01) exists to stop.
readme: This package is the BOOT-01 probe. `pi install` runs npm lifecycle scripts with no --ignore-scripts on any code path (pi 0.84.1 src/core/package-manager.ts:1750,1778,1829), while Pi installs itself WITH --ignore-scripts (src/config.ts:174) -- so the gap is real and the controls are the two committed .npmrc files. A control that is merely present proves nothing: RESEARCH.md 1.3 executed this exact attack and the postinstall RAN through a plausible-looking, correctly-written .npmrc, because --prefix moves npm's project-config lookup away from cwd. This fixture is how the control is proven EFFECTIVE rather than present. It is private, has zero dependencies, is never referenced from the root package.json, and writes exactly one sentinel file to a path the test supplies via KYPI_EVIL_SENTINEL. If you ever see its sentinel outside a deliberate test run, the control has failed -- treat it as a real supply-chain incident, not a test artifact.
